# Bobs Drawn Hoes

---

## Unique Art Style
Ever wanted your hoes to look like they were drawn by someone who has never seen a hoe before? Now they can!

Tired of those realistic texture packs? Then welcome to **Bobs Drawn Hoes**, the only pack where the bad looks are the best part! This pack replaces every single hoe texture, drawn by **me**.
